subject: Request: community research credits and timeline for pilot
messages:
From: Ana Morales <ana@olc.org>
To: elliot_price@redwood.ai
Cc: dev-ops@openlearningcollective.org
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Community pilot credits — request & timing

Hi Elliot,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Open Learning Collective (OLC) runs a small network of community learning hubs across the north of England and we'd like to run a 3-month pilot that uses Redwood for anonymized Q&A and summarization of learner submissions. We have a limited budget but strong interest from three hubs (approx. 20k tokens/day peak).

Could you confirm whether Redwood can offer a one-time promotional credit or trial extension to cover the pilot? Ideally we're looking for ~1M tokens of credit to get through September–November while we secure local sponsorship. If possible, we'd also need an estimate of how quickly credits can be provisioned and whether there's any paperwork you need (W9/PO/charity documentation).

I've attached a brief project overview and our org W9. Happy to share more details if you need them.

Best,
Ana Morales
Program Director, Open Learning Collective
ana@olc.org
attachments: OLC_project_brief.pdf, W9_Open_Learning_Collective.pdf
From: elliot_price@redwood.ai <elliot_price@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Morales <ana@olc.org>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-30T10:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Community pilot credits — request & timing

Hi Ana — great to hear from you and thanks for the brief.

Short answer: yes, we can support a promotional credit and a short trial extension for a non-profit pilot like this. Quick notes/questions so we can move this through approvals fast: 

- Usage estimate: you mentioned ~20k tokens/day peak. Do you expect sustained peak or a spiky pattern (e.g., 3 days/week spikes)?
- Timeline: you asked for September–November. Would you want credits front-loaded (all at once) or monthly installments?
- Legal/billing: for EU non-profits we typically need a PO or a short form agreement; finance will also want the org registration (charity number) in addition to the W9.

Next steps I propose: I can provision a temporary 1M-token credit hold pending manager approval, but I need sign-off from Marissa and confirmation of the pattern above. If you can confirm expected spike pattern and preferred provisioning cadence today, I’ll start the approval ticket.

— Elliot Price
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
elliot_price@redwood.ai
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: elliot_price@redwood.ai
Cc: Ana Morales <ana@olc.org>, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-30T12:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Community pilot credits — request & timing

Elliot / Ana,

Thanks for the context. I reviewed OLC's brief and their footprint looks aligned with our community support program. Approve a provisional credit of 1,000,000 tokens for a three-month pilot with these guardrails: 

- Provision credits in monthly tranches (333k tokens/month) to help monitor consumption and avoid accidental overrun.
- Include a single-month rollover of unused tokens at our discretion.
- Require receipt of charity registration (UK Charity Number) and a signed pilot MSA addendum (two-page credit addendum). I’m happy for Elliot to route the addendum via DocuSign; CS should set up a usage alert at 70% and 90% of each tranche.

David — can you own the PO/finance pathing? If OLC needs invoicing or an exception, please advise.

Ana — once we have the charity number and signed addendum we can start the first tranche within 48 business hours.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Ana Morales <ana@olc.org>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, elliot_price@redwood.ai
Cc: david_kim@redwood.ai, dev-ops@openlearningcollective.org
Date: 2026-08-31T16:22:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Community pilot credits — request & timing

Marissa / Elliot / David — thanks so much, this is perfect. Confirming answers below: 

- Consumption pattern: spikes Thursday/Friday during cohort workshops; otherwise steady ~6–8k tokens/day.
- Provisioning: monthly tranches preferred.
- Charity number: 1145723 (UK Charity Commission).

I've signed the credit addendum and uploaded it to the Drive link here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cOLCbrief (you should have access). If you prefer, I can also route the DocuSign version this afternoon.

We appreciate the roll-forward flexibility. Please let me know if you need any other org docs. Looking forward to starting next week.

Best,
Ana
